We need propose a 3-step retrosynthesis for target: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have hints: step1 forward: carboxylic acid to amide (coupling). So retrosynthetic step: break amide bond to give carboxylic acid and amine.

Step2: Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> alpha,beta-unsaturated carboxylic acid (the /C=C/COOH). So retrosynthetic step: break the double bond and carboxylic acid to give aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid.

Step3: sulfonamide formation: amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide. So retrosynthetic step: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonyl group) and amine.

Thus overall route: target -> (1) amide disconnection gives acid fragment (the unsaturated acid) and aniline fragment (aniline attached to sulfonyl). Actually amide is between C(=O) and N of aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). Wait target: .../C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N . So amide carbonyl attached to N of aniline (aniline with NH2). So retrosynthesis: break amide to give carboxylic acid (the unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Good.

Then the unsaturated acid came from Doebner: aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc...?) Actually the unsaturated acid is attached to aromatic ring via /C=C/COOH attached to phenyl sulfonyl group? The fragment: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonyl. So the unsaturated acid is attached to aromatic ring (c2). The Doebner would generate the alpha,beta-unsaturated acid attached to aromatic ring (aryl aldehyde). So break to give aryl aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid.

Finally sulfonamide formation: break sulfonamide linking the first phenyl (with methyl) to sulfonyl group. So give aniline (the first phenyl with methyl and NH2) and sulfonyl chloride (SO2Cl attached to second phenyl). Actually sulfonyl chloride derived from sulfonyl chloride of second phenyl? The sulfonyl group attached to second phenyl (c2...). So we need sulfonyl chloride: ClSO2-c2ccc(...). So retrosynthesis: target -> break sulfonamide to give p-toluidine (Cc1ccc(N)cc1) and sulfonyl chloride (ClSO2-c2ccc(...)). Then the sulfonyl chloride can be made from the second phenyl (c2) with appropriate substituents.

Thus we need to propose three steps: 1) amide formation, 2) Doebner, 3) sulfonamide formation.

We need to provide JSON route with three reaction nodes each with template_id (we need IDs). We can search for templates matching each transformation.

Search for amide formation (carboxylic acid + amine). Use functional_groups_broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid, functional_groups_formed: amide. Already attempted but got result with template 401931 etc. That template seems to involve amide formation with an alkene? It includes C=C. Might be okay. But we need a template that matches our specific amide: aromatic amide with conjugated alkene? The template 401931 includes amide formation with C=C. Could be used.

Let's retrieve template ID 401931 details via get_template.
